name: GNU Guix
description: Installs GNU Guix using the official binary installation script and configures optional channels, substitutes, and channel pinning.

installNonguix.description: Add the nonguix channel with its recommended introduction metadata.

pinnedChannels.description: Comma-separated channel pins in the form 'channelName=commitHash'.

authorizedSubstitutes.description: Semicolon-separated substitute definitions in the form 'url|keySource'. keySource may be an HTTPS URL, file path, or base64:<key>.
